topic: Landforms and bodies of water influence the environment
key_concepts: Landforms influence living and non-living components of the environment.
Major Philippine landforms include plains, mountains, and islands.
Minor Philippine landforms include plateaus, hills, and valleys.
A plain is a broad area of relatively flat land.
A mountain is a high rising area with steep slopes.
An island is a land area completely surrounded by water.
A plateau is flat land in a high area.
A hill is a smaller rising area with steep slopes compared to a mountain.
A valley is a low area between mountains or hills and often has a river.
Bodies of water such as rivers and coastlines also affect living and non-living things.
UNESCO World Heritage natural sites have outstanding universal value and need protection.
Human activities and living things differ across landforms.
